name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter

locations.note: The Ghosts counter a coup in Mexico City in 2013, after militants attack the summit where the presidents sign the North American security agreement; they defeat anti-air emplacements at the airport and stop an assassination attempt at the U.S. embassy.
The Ghosts assault the castle and secure M1A2 Abrams tanks for the Mexican Army.
The team supports a joint advance into the plaza and rescues Major General Martin from a helicopter crash.

routes.name: The Ghosts
routes.note: From the assault on Chapultepec Castle to the advance into the Zócalo.
